It’s kinda bummer that after I embarrassed myself in front of a girl, Priestbot will die, or rather cease to exist, anyway…
He’s just a bot so convincing him would be meaningless in the end. 
The sad truth is he’s the property of the Church and they can do with him whatever they want.
Updating, formatting or even scraping is nothing unusual for bots.
Well, it was fun for what it was. 
I will probably never meet Shanice ever again, but I’m kinda good at abruptly ending relationships.
Now I can come back to my normal life.
